label: OrbitoX Logo
action: Navigate to platform dashboard / tenant home
rendererEffect: Full page transition to dashboard

label: Project Title Input
action: Rename current project document
rendererEffect: Title text updates in top bar and document metadata

label: Save Status Indicator
action: Displays current persistence sync state
sourceState: Sync state: SAVED | SAVING | DIRTY | ERROR
rendererEffect: Green dot + 'Saved' or pulsing dot + 'Saving...'

label: Undo Button
interaction: Click undo icon or press Cmd+Z
action: Revert to previous history snapshot
rendererEffect: Canvas reverts to previous document state

label: Redo Button
interaction: Click redo icon or press Cmd+Shift+Z
action: Advance to next history snapshot
rendererEffect: Canvas advances to next document state

label: Templates Button
action: Open template catalog modal / drawer
rendererEffect: Overlay modal renders template cards with previews

label: Build Mode
action: Switch studio workspace to document construction mode
rendererEffect: Canvas enables node insertion, drag, resize, and structure editing

label: Style Mode
action: Switch studio workspace to design system & styling mode
rendererEffect: Opens styles drawer rather than switching full workspace mode

label: Motion Mode
action: Switch studio workspace to keyframe timeline & animation mode
rendererEffect: Mounts bottom timeline dock and scrubber

label: Prototype Mode
action: Switch studio workspace to interaction wiring mode
rendererEffect: Enables interaction connector wires between sections/pages

label: 3D Mode
action: Switch studio workspace to WebGL/Three.js spatial scene mode
rendererEffect: Mounts 3D spatial viewport with camera controls and lights

label: Performance Badge
action: Displays site performance telemetry
rendererEffect: Shows '⚡ 100% Optimal'

label: Desktop Viewport (1440px)
action: Set active canvas viewport breakpoint to desktop
rendererEffect: Canvas artboard expands to 1440px with base desktop styles

label: Tablet Viewport (768px)
action: Set active canvas viewport breakpoint to tablet
rendererEffect: Canvas artboard resizes to 768px, applying tablet responsive overrides

label: Mobile Viewport (390px)
action: Set active canvas viewport breakpoint to mobile
rendererEffect: Canvas artboard resizes to 390px, applying mobile responsive overrides

label: Zoom Out (-)
action: Decrease canvas viewport zoom level by 10%
rendererEffect: Canvas container scales down smoothly around viewport center

label: Zoom Percentage Readout
interaction: Click to select or reset to 100%
action: Reset zoom level to 100% or open zoom preset menu
rendererEffect: Canvas scales to 1:1 pixel parity

label: Zoom In (+)
action: Increase canvas viewport zoom level by 10%
rendererEffect: Canvas container scales up smoothly around viewport center

label: Ask AI Button
action: Open AI Assistant drawer / prompt palette
targetState: AI drawer open with contextual section prompts
rendererEffect: Drawer slides in from right or bottom with natural language input

label: Import Button
action: Open Universal Import Modal
targetState: Import modal open with drag/drop and preset tabs
rendererEffect: Modal mounts over canvas with file upload and code input

label: Preview Button
action: Open isolated responsive live preview modal / route
targetState: Preview mode active without studio chrome
rendererEffect: Mounts standalone iframe/runtime rendering resolved project document

label: Share Button
action: Open project collaboration & link sharing modal
targetState: Share modal open with tenant URL and permissions
rendererEffect: Displays shareable preview link and permission toggles

label: Publish Button
action: Create immutable release snapshot and deploy to edge CDN
rendererEffect: Displays deployment confirmation modal with live custom domain URL

label: Section Navigation Pill
interaction: Click section pill (e.g. '1. Hero & Product Preview')
action: Scroll canvas to section and select section in inspector
sourceState: Previous section selected or no selection
targetState: Target section active and in viewport
rendererEffect: Canvas smooth scrolls to target section; section outline glows

label: + Add Section Button
action: Open section catalog palette to insert new section
targetState: Section palette open with categorized section presets
rendererEffect: Drawer or modal displays hero, feature, pricing, and footer templates

label: Section Drag Handle (::)
action: Reorder section position within the page
rendererEffect: Drag ghost follows pointer; insertion indicator shows drop target

label: Section Move Up (↑)
action: Swap section with preceding sibling section
rendererEffect: Section shifts above previous section on canvas

label: Section Move Down (↓)
action: Swap section with succeeding sibling section
rendererEffect: Section shifts below next section on canvas

label: Section Duplicate Button
action: Clone section with deep-copied unique node IDs
targetState: Page contains N+1 sections with cloned subtree
rendererEffect: Cloned section appears immediately beneath source section

label: Section Variant Switcher
action: Cycle or pick alternative visual variant for current section
rendererEffect: Section layout and typography re-theme to next design variant

label: Section Delete Button
action: Remove section from page document
targetState: Page sections array without section S
rendererEffect: Section unmounts from canvas; remaining sections reflow upward

label: Element Selection Box
action: Establish selected node identity in store
rendererEffect: Selection bounding box highlights node with 8 resize handles

label: 2D Element Drag Movement
action: Reposition node within parent coordinates or freeform canvas
rendererEffect: Node moves smoothly following pointer with snapping guides

label: Southeast Resize Handle
interaction: PointerDown on bottom-right handle and drag
action: Update node width and height
targetState: width: W + dw, height: H + dh
rendererEffect: Node boundary smoothly stretches to follow handle

label: Rotation Handle
interaction: PointerDown on circular rotation handle above node
action: Rotate node around transform center
rendererEffect: Node rotates smoothly with angle degree tooltip

label: Asset File Drag & Drop
interaction: Drag image/video/font from OS desktop onto canvas
action: Upload asset to tenant registry and insert node at drop coordinate
targetState: New ImageNode created with asset URL
rendererEffect: Image renders at dropped position with selection box

label: Pages / Navigation Drawer
action: Open multi-page site navigation drawer
rendererEffect: Pages drawer mounts showing list of site routes and SEO settings

label: Add Element (+) Drawer
action: Open universal insert drawer (Sections, Primitives, Components)
rendererEffect: Insert drawer displays drag-to-canvas elements

label: Layers Drawer
action: Open tree view of all visual nodes on active page
rendererEffect: Displays hierarchical DOM/SceneGraph tree synchronized with canvas

label: Components Drawer
action: Open reusable components & symbols drawer
rendererEffect: Displays master components and instance libraries

label: Assets Drawer
action: Open project media and uploaded files manager
rendererEffect: Displays uploaded images, videos, icons, and fonts grid

label: Design Tokens & Styles Drawer
action: Open design token manager (Colors, Typography, Radius, Shadows)
rendererEffect: Displays global tokens and theme preset switcher

label: Collections & CMS Drawer
action: Open structured CMS content collections manager
rendererEffect: Displays collections (Posts, Products, Team) and schemas

label: Section Name Input
action: Update section human-readable identifier
rendererEffect: Updates label in layers tree and breadcrumbs

label: Navigation Anchor Input
action: Update HTML anchor ID (e.g. #hero)
rendererEffect: Section DOM element receives id attribute for in-page linking

label: Remix Section Art Direction
interaction: Click purple 'Remix Section Art Direction' button
action: AI generative art-direction restyling for current section
rendererEffect: Section typography, colors, and gradients update instantly

label: Page Transition Preset
action: Set scroll enter/exit animation preset for section
rendererEffect: Section animates with selected preset when scrolled into view

label: Visual Box Model Padding
interaction: Drag or type in top/right/bottom/left padding input
action: Set inner container padding
rendererEffect: Node internal spacing expands visibly

label: Visual Box Model Margin
interaction: Drag or type in top/right/bottom/left margin input
action: Set external container margin
rendererEffect: Node shifts relative to siblings

label: Corner Radius Control
interaction: Click radius preset (0, 8, 16, 24, Pill) or type custom
action: Set border radius for element
rendererEffect: Element corners round visibly on canvas

label: Font Family Selector
interaction: Pick font family from visual specimen dropdown
action: Apply font family and inject dynamic @font-face stylesheet
rendererEffect: Canvas text renders in new font glyphs immediately
persistence: SceneGraph node style & Document fonts registry

label: Font Size & Line Height
interaction: Type number or drag scrub label
action: Set fontSize and lineHeight style
rendererEffect: Text scales up with proper leading

label: Color Swatch & Token Picker
interaction: Click swatch, pick hex or select design system token
action: Update color property (fill, text, border)
rendererEffect: Node updates fill or stroke color immediately

label: CMS Field Binding Dropdown
action: Bind node content property to dynamic schema field
rendererEffect: Text displays resolved record value from collection

label: Hierarchy Breadcrumb
interaction: Click breadcrumb segment (Page > Section > Frame > Text)
action: Select parent or ancestor node in SceneGraph
rendererEffect: Selection bounding box expands to ancestor node

label: FPS & Telemetry Readout
action: Display real-time rendering frame rate
rendererEffect: Displays '🟢 60 FPS • Edge CDN • 100% Optimal'

label: Fullscreen Toggle
action: Toggle browser document fullscreen API
rendererEffect: Expands studio to entire monitor viewport

label: Keyboard Shortcuts Button
action: Open keyboard shortcut reference cheatsheet modal
rendererEffect: Displays categorized list of shortcut keys (V, H, R, T, Cmd+D, etc.)

label: Empty Canvas Context Menu
action: Open contextual right-click menu for page/canvas operations
targetState: Context menu open with Add Section, Paste, Import, Settings
rendererEffect: Floating glass context menu mounts at pointer coordinate

label: Selected Node Context Menu
action: Open node actions menu (Copy, Duplicate, Delete, Group, Bring to Front)
targetState: Context menu open at pointer position
rendererEffect: Menu mounts with Copy, Cut, Paste, Duplicate, Delete, Select Layer >

label: Select Layer > Submenu
action: Display overlapping visual hierarchy stack to disambiguate selection
targetState: Submenu open listing Section > Frame > Content > Heading > Button
rendererEffect: Flyout submenu displays exact hit-test hierarchy for selection

label: Universal Clipboard (Cmd+C / Cmd+V)
interaction: Press Cmd+C on node, then Cmd+V
action: Serialize canonical node and deserialize with new unique ID
targetState: Node serialized in clipboard; pasted as sibling
rendererEffect: Duplicate node appears offset by +16px from original
persistence: System clipboard / In-memory JSON & Document SceneGraph
